lines.1: 「Well, I'll do enough to meet my quota.」
lines.4: 「Hm. There are still small stains left. Look, for example, at this mark on the wall.」
lines.5: Otome sprayed cleaner on it and scrubbed hard with a cloth.
lines.6: 「If you work carefully like this, it will come clean.」
lines.7: 「This is the house you live in. Put some spirit into it.」
lines.8: Damn. She would not allow any compromise.
